Dataset Purpose: To generate estimates of employment and unemployment characteristics in India at national and state levels.
Geographic Coverage: The whole of India except Nagaland interior villages and Andaman & Nicobar.
Population Coverage: Not explicitly specified in the dataset documentation.
Key Variables: HH_Size (Household size), Land_Owned (Area of land owned), Sector (Rural/Urban sector), State (State name), Religion (Household religion)
Sample Size / Scope: Approximately 115,000 households were surveyed.
Important Notes: A stratified multi-stage design was used., Subsample-wise weights (multipliers) are provided., The survey was conducted from July 2011 to June 2012 by NSSO.
